title: A Pool Fit for a Hedgehog
mainIdea: Researching before making a decision can help people choose wisely.

pages.text: Cora visited her friend Heather and saw her new pool. The weather was very hot.
Cora enjoyed the pool and thought it would be nice to have one of her own.
Before buying a pool, Cora needed to choose the best company.

options: She did not know which company to choose
She did not like swimming in her friend's pool

pages.text: Cora researched prices, reviews, and other companies before making her decision.

question.text: What did Cora do to solve her problem?
options: She asked no questions before buying a pool

pages.text: A week later, Cora had her own pool and thanked Heather for the recommendation.

options: Cora bought a pool and enjoyed it
Cora changed her mind about buying a pool

elements.correct: Her own pool for the hot summer days
distractors: A trip to the beach with her friend Heather
A garden with shade trees for hot days

elements.correct: She needed to decide which company to buy from
distractors: She forgot the name of Heather's pool company
She had to wait for a builder to call her back

elements.correct: She researched different pool companies and reviews
distractors: She asked Heather to choose the company for her
She picked the first company in the phone book

elements.correct: She got her own pool and thanked Heather
distractors: She changed her mind about the pool
She gave her brand new pool away to Heather
